content:
OK. Algorithm saved as algorithms/jumps.js and sent to Max (jumps).
Selector, checked on the score in the roll (893 notes). In Max every change asks the roll for its score and selects in it.
Parameters (now a panel in Max):
  gap: slider 50..2000 ms = 300
  interval: slider 0..1200 mc = 300
  mode: menu [exact, less than, greater than] = exact
Checked in 7 runs (every slider at its minimum and maximum, every option).
At the declared values it picks 72 notes ([voice chord note]): [1 3 1], [1 4 1], [1 6 1], [1 7 1], [1 9 1], [1 10 1], [1 21 1], [1 22 1], [1 30 1], [1 31 1], [1 35 1], [1 36 1], [1 38 1], [1 39 1], [1 45 1], [1 46 1], [1 50 1], [1 51 1], [1 54 1], [1 55 1], [1 57 1], [1 58 1], [1 65 1], [1 66 1] ...

Sent: the selector segments each voice into phrases by `gap`, then picks adjacent note pairs whose interval is exact, less than, or greater than the chosen `interval` — always within a phrase, never across one.
